verdict.rationale: Segment's Public API docs mention token-based authentication with explicit "Scope, Permissions and security" sections, implying support for creating limited-permission API tokens that could be used for an agent's programmatic access [segment-docs-x2]. However, there is no explicit mention of agent-specific credentialing, granular per-resource scopes, or workflows tailored to AI-native agent use. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential issuance, detailed scope/permission taxonomy, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement.
